purpose: Register a paired validation-only screen for a low-rank CMamba-inspired channel-preserving modulation attached to the existing AutoCon MambaACF variable-token branch.
research_question: Under one fixed Mamba2, train-only ACF memory, and AutoCon relation protocol, does a data-dependent channel-preserving GDD adapter improve H96 forecasting without exceeding a declared resource budget?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory screen on ETTh1, ETTm1, electricity, and traffic at H96 with three seeds. It is candidate-selection evidence only and cannot establish a general Mamba, ACF, speed, or publication claim.
claim_boundary: The treatment is a CMamba-inspired low-rank adapter implemented locally; it is not an exact CMamba reproduction. ACF supplies temporal forecast-memory support and AutoCon supplies an auxiliary representation objective; neither is a cross-channel graph. Representation causality remains window-global when variable-token fusion is enabled.

required_before_launch: review the one-factor GDD off/on design and four-dataset H96 scope
verify source snapshot, mamba environment, and all dataset SHA256 fingerprints
run matched prediction and representation resource smoke on the same GPU
freeze this JSON and create an approved launch sidecar
use validation only for selection; do not use test metrics to promote an arm

prelaunch_gates: review the one-factor GDD off/on design and four-dataset H96 scope
verify source snapshot, mamba environment, and all dataset SHA256 fingerprints
run matched prediction and representation resource smoke on the same GPU
freeze this JSON and create an approved launch sidecar
use validation only for selection; do not use test metrics to promote an arm

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, model arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh exploratory output root. Retain source snapshot, environment, dataset hashes, plan/config hashes, manifests, train-only ACF priors, checkpoints, validation trajectories, and phase validation. Do not copy historical metrics into this matrix.

phases.name: mamba2_plain_h96
phases.purpose: Plain Mamba2 reference under the shared short-budget protocol.

phases.name: patchtst_plain_h96
phases.purpose: PatchTST reference under exactly the same dataset, horizon, seed, optimizer, and validation-only budget.

phases.name: mamba_acf_variable_gdd_off_h96
phases.purpose: AutoCon MambaACF control with variable-token forecast and representation branches, static train-only ACF memory, and no GDD adapter. The dormant GDD init scale is fixed globally and has no effect in this arm.

phases.name: mamba_acf_variable_gdd_on_h96
phases.purpose: Treatment with the same AutoCon MambaACF pipeline plus one low-rank channel-preserving GDD adapter after the variable-token Mamba scan. The adapter uses a fixed 0.01 initial residual scale so its affine subnetwork receives a first-step gradient.

pairing_contract.interpretation: The GDD off/on contrast is the primary architecture screen. Mamba2 and PatchTST are protocol-matched references only; historical matrices are not pooled with this screen.

accuracy_gate.gdd_vs_control: For each dataset, mean validation MSE ratio treatment/control <= 1.000, at least 2 of 3 paired seed wins, and no seed ratio above 1.05.
accuracy_gate.reference_context: Report ratios against Mamba2 and PatchTST descriptively; no non-inferiority or universal claim is allowed from this screen.
accuracy_gate.uncertainty: Report every seed and paired confidence interval; the statistical unit is dataset-horizon-seed, not windows or channels.

resource_gate.protocol: Same source snapshot, RTX 5090 D, device-resident synthetic input, batch=8, warmup=25, timed=100, synchronized timing, and separate prediction/representation calls.
resource_gate.gdd_vs_control: Median/p95 latency, steady-state peak allocated memory, and trainable parameter count must each be <= 1.10x control on ETTh1 and traffic; a speed claim requires measured wall-clock evidence.
resource_gate.missing_measurement: Any mixed protocol or missing resource row invalidates the efficiency gate.

comparison_contract.promotion_rule: Only a fresh human-reviewed confirmation plan with complete multi-seed artifacts may support a paper claim. This draft cannot establish publication readiness.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validation and dry-run are permitted.
Do not tune rank, lambda, relation target, or ACF lag set after seeing validation results in this screen.
If GDD fails the control gate or adds cost without a consistent gain, retain the simpler control and stop this branch.
Do not use test metrics to select an arm or merge this screen with historical result tables.
